newsitem.title: USA: Linotype-Hell to focus on core businesses.
newsitem.headline: Linotype-Hell to focus on core businesses.

text.p: Linotype-Hell AG said that after its current restructuring is completed, it will undergo a strategic market repositioning and would concentrate on its core and system business, the company said Monday.
The plan was outlined by the chairman of its executive board, Bernhard Schreier, who spoke at a press conference last week in Heidelberg, Germany, the company said.
As part of the plan, all of the company's operations will be controlled from its technology and production center in Kiel, the company said.

Effective April 1, the company also plans to spin off a number of its business segments and reorganize these into independent subsidiaries, it said. These include the LinoPress newspaper and publishing system, the fonts sector, the gravure sector and the desktop scanner segment, it said.
Ultre Inc, a U.S. unit that produces and sells small imagesetters, will also become an independent unit, it said.

Linotype-Hell said that in the course of the year, the sales companies of Linotype-Hell AG in North America, the U.K. and Austria will be integrated into the sales companies of Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG.
On the domestic front, the German sales organization will be restructured into an independent company with a view to its incorporation into Heidelberger Druckmaschinen, it said.
It said it will concentrate its activities in Kiel on the Baltic Coast by September 30 and will close its site in Eschborn near Frankfurt.
After the merger with Heidelberger Druckmaschinen, Linotype-Hell will trade under the name "BU PrePress" but will retain its product names, it said.
